title: Bridgetown, Cooly, Fuerty, Co. Roscommon, F42ED86
seoTitle: Bridgetown, Cooly, Fuerty, Co. Roscommon, F42ED86
description:
A beautifully appointed country residence with equestrian facilities

Bridgetown is an impressive country residence occupying a private and mature setting on about 21.5 acres of good-quality pastureland. Approached through a gated entrance and along a sweeping tree-lined driveway, the property immediately conveys a strong sense of arrival, privacy and exclusivity. Set amidst beautifully maintained grounds and paddocks, the residence enjoys a peaceful rural setting while benefiting from excellent connectivity to Roscommon Town, Athlone and Galway.

Occupying an elevated position overlooking its own lands, the residence commands attractive views across the surrounding countryside. Mature trees, landscaped lawns and well-defined boundaries create an idyllic setting, perfectly suited to family living. Extending to a generous scale throughout, the residence is presented to an exceptionally high standard, with bright, well-proportioned interiors thoughtfully designed for modern lifestyles. A striking double-height entrance hall with feature staircase creates an immediate sense of space and elegance on arrival, setting the tone for the quality and finish evident throughout the home.

At the heart of the property lies a superb open-plan kitchen, breakfast and dining area. Beautifully appointed with bespoke solid wood cabinetry, polished granite worktops, a peninsula island and a Belling induction range cooker, this impressive space successfully combines practicality with timeless style. Large windows and glazed doors flood the room with natural light while providing seamless access to the patio and gardens, making it equally suited to everyday family living and entertaining.

The reception accommodation is equally impressive, comprising a selection of generously proportioned living spaces finished in warm neutral tones and complemented by quality flooring, feature fireplaces and attractive countryside views. A substantial dual-aspect family room provides an inviting setting for relaxation, while a separate living room and dedicated home office offer excellent flexibility for modern family life, remote working and home-based business needs.

On the first floor, a spacious gallery landing leads to five beautifully presented bedrooms. The master bedroom suite is particularly impressive and features a walk-in wardrobe together with a luxurious ensuite bathroom finished to a high specification. Four further double bedrooms provide comfortable and versatile accommodation, one of which also benefits from ensuite facilities. A beautifully appointed family bathroom, complete with bath and separate shower, serves the remaining bedrooms.

Throughout, the property has been well maintained and finished to an exacting standard, offering a superb balance of elegant accommodation, practical family living space and modern comfort.

Outside

Complementing the residence is a substantial detached garage building incorporating twin garage bays and a superb first-floor entertainment room, currently used as guest accommodation, including a bathroom. With independent access, this versatile space is ideally suited to a variety of recreational, leisure, home office or ancillary accommodation uses, subject to any necessary consents.

The property enjoys an outstanding range of equestrian and agricultural facilities. A steel-framed shed with profile metal cladding and roofing is centred around a large concrete yard, providing extensive hardstanding for vehicle manoeuvring, machinery storage and general operational use. Internally, the building incorporates six stables, two foaling bays, a tack room, W.C., horse wash bay and a dedicated hay/storage area, making it exceptionally well equipped for equestrian purposes.

In addition, there is a second detached steel-framed agricultural shed with concrete flooring and excellent storage capacity, suitable for fodder, machinery, livestock housing or a variety of general agricultural uses.

Further enhancing the holding are two sand arenas, comprising a principal riding arena and a dedicated lunging arena, together with well-defined paddocks enclosed by high-quality stock-proof fencing. The fencing infrastructure was comprehensively upgraded in 2025, creating secure and well-defined paddocks. The lands are ideally suited to equestrian, hobby farming and lifestyle use, making this a superb turnkey country and equestrian property.

Situated in the heart of County Roscommon, between the picturesque villages of Castlecoote and Fuerty, the area is renowned for its peaceful rural setting, rolling farmland and strong equestrian heritage. Positioned close to the River Suck and on the Roscommon/Galway border, the location offers the perfect balance of countryside living and accessibility to a wide range of amenities.

The award-winning heritage village of Castlecoote, offers a charming collection of local amenities including a primary school, convenience shop, pub and community facilities. The nearby village of Athleague provides further everyday services, sporting clubs and recreational amenities, while Roscommon Town (9 km) offers an extensive range of supermarkets, boutiques, cafés, restaurants, hotels, healthcare services and both primary and secondary schools.

Roscommon Town (9 km) offers a comprehensive range of amenities including supermarkets, boutique retail outlets, cafés, restaurants, hotels, healthcare facilities and sporting clubs. The town is home to a number of highly regarded primary and secondary schools, while its historic town centre, public parks and recreational amenities contribute to its popularity as a residential and commercial hub for the wider region.

Athlone (35 km) located on the River Shannon and providing direct access to the M6 motorway linking Dublin and Galway. The town offers an extensive range of shopping, dining and leisure facilities, including Athlone Towncentre Shopping Centre and Golden Island Shopping Centre. Educational facilities include the internationally recognised Technological University of the Shannon (TUS), while the town also benefits from excellent healthcare services, hotels, marinas and a vibrant hospitality sector.

Galway City (81 km) is widely regarded as the cultural capital of Ireland's west coast and is recognised for its thriving commercial, educational and tourism sectors. The city offers an exceptional selection of retail, dining and entertainment amenities, together with leading third-level institutions including the University of Galway and Atlantic Technological University (ATU). Renowned for its festivals, arts scene and coastal setting, Galway combines international connectivity and employment opportunities

The area is particularly renowned for its strong equestrian heritage. The property itself is comprehensively equipped with six stables, tack room, sand arena and well-fenced paddocks, while the surrounding region is home to a number of established equestrian centres, riding schools, training yards and liveries. Racing enthusiasts are exceptionally well catered for. Roscommon Racecourse is located just minutes from the property and hosts a highly regarded summer racing programme. The internationally acclaimed Galway Racecourse, home to the famous Galway Races Summer Festival, is also within easy reach, further enhancing the property's appeal for those involved in or passionate about the equestrian and bloodstock industries.

Outdoor recreation opportunities are abundant throughout the area, including fishing and boating along the River Suck and River Shannon waterways, scenic walking and cycling routes, and numerous sporting clubs. The nearby Suck Valley Way, including the popular Castlecoote to Ballygar walking route, offers exceptional countryside walking through some of Roscommon's most attractive landscapes. The wider region also benefits from excellent golf facilities, country pursuits and equestrian amenities.

The nearby road network provides convenient access to Athlone, Galway, Sligo and Dublin, while rail services from Roscommon and Athlone offer regular connections to Dublin and the west of Ireland. The property is also ideally positioned for international travel, with Ireland West Airport Knock (63 km), Shannon Airport (137 km) and Dublin Airport (163 km) all readily accessible, offering a wide range of domestic and international flight connections.

The residence was constructed in 2009 and boasts a strong B3 BER rating, offering an excellent blend of efficiency and modern convenience. Internally, the property benefits from oil-fired central heating with underfloor heating, fibre broadband connectivity, a beam vacuum system and a converted attic providing additional usable space. The heating system was comprehensively upgraded in 2025, including the installation of a new Firebird boiler, further enhancing the efficiency and performance of the home.

Externally, the property is accessed via electric gates and is serviced by mains water with a water softening system and a private septic tank. The lands are well equipped for agricultural and equestrian use, with water troughs installed throughout the paddocks.
features: Well presented five-bedroom residence in turnkey condition
Superb equestrian facilities comprising stables, tack room, two sand arenas and well sized divisions with stock proof fencing
Located in a private and peaceful country setting
Convenient access to three international airports
